remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "WM acq. card: P.16001. . . . Acquired 11/17/31. Bought from Reinhardt Gal, Nov. 11, 1931 for $450. Miss O'Keeffe not certain when painted –– possibly No. 23 in O'Keeffe exh. at Intimate Gal, Jan.–Feb. 1928" [not in 1928 exhibition, for work in that exhibition, see cat. entry 547 or 627]. Whitney Archive and Downtown Gallery Archive date c. 1922. Abiquiú Notebooks dates 1927. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
